description: Transforming drug discovery with AI. 1910 Genetics is the only biotechnology company advancing small and large molecule drug discovery with a multimodal AI platform powered by laboratory automation.
Go where humans go. Human-like capabilities allow Agility Robotics’ Digit to work with and alongside us, without modifying our offices, factories, or homes.

Redefining gene editing with RNA. Amber Bio is developing an RNA editing platform that enables large, precise edits without altering DNA, allowing a single drug to safely treat complex genetic diseases.

Making the public cloud private. By securing data-in-use, Anjuna makes secure cloud computing viable for the first time. Insider threats become a thing of the past, and the confidential cloud can become a reality.

Decoding RNA to unlock the next generation of medicine. Atomic AI’s foundation models accurately predict RNA structure and biophysical properties from RNA sequence, transforming RNA drug discovery into a scalable, data-driven process.
Powering AI with silicon photonics. Ayar Labs solves the I/O bandwidth and power bottlenecks by moving data using light, enabling new system architectures and topologies.
Transforming the way heart disease is managed. Bodyport uses advanced cardiac monitoring and digital therapeutics to improve heart disease management with simple, easy-to-use devices.
Parcel logistics transformed. Boxbot’s automated storage, sequencing and sortation platform reduces sorting costs by 70% and triples facility throughput.
Smarter AI inference starts here. d-Matrix is redefining AI inference with in-memory compute to make it faster, more efficient, and less power-hungry.
Flight delays can’t snowball. Planes arrive on time, safely and sustainability using a non-invasive electric deicing system that allows aircrafts to deice themselves
Renewable metals. Element Zero is changing the way we produce critical materials by replacing coal with sunlight and wind, eliminating carbon emissions and offering unparalleled economics.
Making one-hour delivery fast, easy, and profitable. Fabric is an on-demand micro-fulfillment platform that enables businesses to fulfill orders quickly and profitability using automation.
Elevating photosynthesis. GigaCrop is reinventing photosynthesis using machine learning and enzyme engineering to boost crop yield and drought tolerance for a more prosperous and resilient world.
Drill less, discover more. Ideon uses cosmic-ray muon tomography to enable x-ray-like visibility deep beneath the Earth’s surface, identifying the resources needed to fuel the energy transformation.

Transforming human antibodies into life-saving drugs. Infinimmune’s proprietary sequencing and bioinformatics platform accesses the human immune system's antibody library, which is combined with AI to create safer and more effective therapies for complex diseases.

Breaking drug discovery barriers. Insamo leverages trillion molecule screening libraries and AI to develop macrocyclic peptide drugs that cross cell membranes and can be taken orally, unlocking new treatments for previously untargetable diseases.

Transforming drug discovery with precision design. Manifold Bio’s groundbreaking “high throughput vivo” (HTV) platform allows for the testing of 100’s of biologics in a single animal. This uniquely scaled in vivo dataset powers AI models to develop tissue-targeting medicines starting with first-in-class neuroshuttles.
Smarter driving, safer roads. Nauto’s predictive AI helps drivers prevent collisions in real-time—reducing risk without compromising privacy.

10-100x faster replacement for CPUs and GPUs. Our exponential appetite for compute can only be satisfied with radical new approaches. NextSilicon runs existing high performance code orders of magnitude faster.
Creating immersive hybrid meetings. Owl Labs makes hybrid meetings better with intelligent conference cameras, mics, and speakers.
The quantum algorithms company. Phasecraft’s research has led to fundamental breakthroughs in quantum science, and has made it the market leader in quantum algorithms and applications.

Solving the Bandwidth Gulf of AI Data Centers. PicoJool replaces copper with optical fiber in demanding AI and supercomputing applications to offer unprecedented low power, low cost and high throughput.

Reimagining power delivery for next-generation AI accelerators. Powerlattice built the industry's first power delivery chiplet to deliver breakthrough performance, efficiency, and reliability for AI and data center infrastructure.

A million qubit quantum computer that can answer impossible questions. PsiQuantum’s unique architecture will yield powerful quantum computers within a handful of years with clear applications across pharma, materials, finance & energy.
Saving lives with Apple, Uber, and 911. RapidSOS delivers life-saving data from connected devices directly to 911 and first responders—bringing emergency services into the digital age.
Building humanity’s multiplanetary future. Relativity Space is building the first autonomous rocket factory and launch services for satellites. They are disrupting 60 years of aerospace.

Flying robots with unprecedented intelligence. Skydio Autonomy™ has the skills of an expert pilot. It uses AI to understand the world around it and predict into the future to make intelligent decisions.

Syenta is architecting the future of AI computing through its revolutionary Localized Electrochemical Manufacturing (LEM) technology, which enables High-Resolution Interconnects -a new class of chip-to-chip connections that transcends traditional packaging to deliver wafer-level system integration at unprecedented density.

Pioneering next-generation cancer therapeutics. Synthetic Design Lab is developing a platform to create highly precise Antibody-Drug Conjugates (ADCs), aiming to deliver more powerful and effective treatments for a broad range of cancers.
Reversing Type 2 diabetes. Virta Health provides a proven treatment that helps patients sustainably reverse Type 2 diabetes, with data showing major reductions in insulin use within 100 days.

Advanced semiconductors in a new light. xLight is building a new kind of extreme ultraviolet light source for creating the most advanced semiconductors breaking new ground in power, fidelity, and efficiency.
